25886-the-young-lieutenant-or-the-advent.title: A Story of the Great Rebellion
25886-the-young-lieutenant-or-the-advent.creator: Oliver Optic
25886-the-young-lieutenant-or-the-advent.description: A book by Oliver Optic. nt Somers needs any further introduction to the reader, we may briefly add, that he was a native of Pinchbrook, a town near Boston, in the State of Massachusetts. He was now entering his eighteenth year, and had enlisted in the great army of the Union as a private, with an earnest and patriotic desire to serve his imperiled country in her death-grapple with treason and traitors.

37193-the-swedish-fairy-book.title: The Swedish Fairy Book
37193-the-swedish-fairy-book.creator: Unknown
37193-the-swedish-fairy-book.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Once upon a time there was a poor widow, who found an egg under a pile of brush as she was gathering kindlings in the forest. She took it and placed it under a goose, and when the goose had hatched it, a little boy slipped out of the shell.

agrippa-de-occulta-philosophia-1533-lati.description: Agrippa's Three Books of Occult Philosophy in the 1533 Cologne first edition Latin — the foundational synthesis of Renaissance magic.

arxiv-2101-09941.title: Local Well-posedness for Free Boundary Problem of Viscous Incompressible Magnetohydrodynamics
arxiv-2101-09941.creator: Kenta Oishi and Yoshihiro Shibata
arxiv-2101-09941.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the motion of incompressible magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) with resistivity in a domain bounded by a free surface. An electromagnetic field generated by some currents in an external domain keeps an MHD flow in a bounded domain. On the free surface, free boundary conditions for MHD flow and transmission conditions for electromagnetic fields are imposed.

arxiv-2108-07982.title: Microscopic investigation of superconducting properties of a strongly coupled superconductor IrGe via μ \mu SR
arxiv-2108-07982.creator: Arushi, Kapil Motla, P. K. Meena, S. Sharma, D. Singh, P. K. Biswas, A. D. Hillier, R. P. Singh
arxiv-2108-07982.description: Abstract Exploring superconductors which can possess pairing mechanism other than the BCS predicted s-wave have continually attracted considerable interest. Superconductors with low-lying phonons may exhibit unconventional superconductivity as the coupling of electrons with these low-lying phonons can potentially affect the nature of the superconducting ground state, resulting in strongly coupled superconductivity.

arxiv-2206-10143.title: A Contrastive Approach to Online Change Point Detection Thanks: The preliminary version of this paper [ 47 ] was presented at the 26th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS), 2023.
arxiv-2206-10143.creator: Artur Goldman, Nikita Puchkin, Valeriia Shcherbakova, Uliana Vinogradova
arxiv-2206-10143.description: Abstract We suggest a novel procedure for online change point detection. Our approach expands an idea of maximizing a discrepancy measure between points from pre-change and post-change distributions. This leads to flexible algorithms suitable for both parametric and nonparametric scenarios. We prove non-asymptotic bounds on the average running length of the procedure and its expected detection delay.

arxiv-2303-17025.title: Deep convolutional neural networks to restore single-shot electron microscopy images
arxiv-2303-17025.creator: I. Lobato, T. Friedrich, S. Van Aert
arxiv-2303-17025.description: Abstract State-of-the-art electron microscopes such as scanning electron microscopes (SEM), scanning transmission electron microscopes (STEM) and transmission electron microscopes (TEM) have become increasingly sophisticated. However, the quality of experimental images is often hampered by stochastic and deterministic distortions arising from the instrument or its environment.

arxiv-2309-05464.title: On the absence of the electrostriction force in dilute clouds of cold atoms
arxiv-2309-05464.creator: Arnaud Courvoisier, Nir Davidson
arxiv-2309-05464.description: Abstract The momentum of light in a medium and the mechanisms of momentum transfer between light and dielectrics have long been the topic of controversies and confusion Milonni and Boyd 2010 ; Landau and Lifshitz 1984 ; Brevik 1979 ; Brevik 2018 .

arxiv-2312-03031.title: Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
arxiv-2312-03031.creator: Zhiqi Li, Zhiding Yu, Shiyi Lan, Jiahan Li, Jan Kautz, Tong Lu, Jose M. Alvarez, [0.15cm] National Key Lab for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University NVIDIA
arxiv-2312-03031.description: Abstract End-to-end autonomous driving recently emerged as a promising research direction to target autonomy from a full-stack perspective. Along this line, many of the latest works follow an open-loop evaluation setting on nuScenes to study the planning behavior. In this paper, we delve deeper into the problem by conducting thorough analyses and demystifying more devils in the details.

arxiv-2402-11339.title: Expressive Higher-Order Link Prediction through Hypergraph Symmetry Breaking
arxiv-2402-11339.creator: Simon Zhang zhan4125@purdue.edu, Cheng Xin cx122@cs.rutgers.edu, Tamal K. Dey tamaldey@purdue.edu
arxiv-2402-11339.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Simon Zhang zhan4125@purdue.edu, Cheng Xin cx122@cs.rutgers.edu, Tamal K. Dey tamaldey@purdue.edu. A hypergraph consists of a set of nodes along with a collection of subsets of the nodes called hyperedges. Higher order link prediction is the task of predicting the existence of a missing hyperedge in a hypergraph. A hyperedge representation learned for higher order link prediction is fully expressive when it does not lose distinguishing power up to an isomorphism.

arxiv-2506-22567.title: Unifying Biomedical Vision-Language Expertise: Towards a Generalist Foundation Model via Multi-CLIP Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2506-22567.creator: Shansong Wang, Zhecheng Jin, Mingzhe Hu, Mojtaba Safari, Feng Zhao, Chih-Wei Chang, Richard LJ Qiu, Justin Roper, David S. Yu, Xiaofeng Yang
arxiv-2506-22567.description: Abstract CLIP models pretrained on natural images with billion-scale image-text pairs have demonstrated impressive capabilities in zero-shot classification, cross-modal retrieval, and open-ended visual answering. However, transferring this success to biomedicine is hindered by the scarcity of large-scale biomedical image-text corpora, the heterogeneity of image modalities, and fragmented data standards across institutions.

arxiv-2508-03586.title: DeepFaith: A Domain-Free and Model-Agnostic Unified Framework for Highly Faithful Explanations
arxiv-2508-03586.creator: Yuhan Guo, Lizhong Ding, Shihan Jia, Yanyu Ren, Pengqi Li, Jiarun Fu
arxiv-2508-03586.description: Abstract Explainable AI (XAI) builds trust in complex systems through model attribution methods that reveal the decision rationale. However, due to the absence of a unified optimal explanation, existing XAI methods lack a ground truth for objective evaluation and optimization.

pmc-10625071.creator: Shuo‐En Wu, Longhui Zeng, Yichen Zhai, Chanho Shin, Naresh Eedugurala, Jason D. Azoulay, Tse Nga Ng
pmc-10625071.description: Organic retinomorphic sensors offer the advantage of in‐sensor processing to filter out redundant static backgrounds and are well suited for motion detection. To improve this promising structure, here, the key role of interfacial energetics in promoting charge accumulation to raise the inherent photoresponse of the light‐sensitive capacitor is studied.

pmc-11686521.title: Regulatory gaps in India’s medical device framework: The case of Johnson and Johnson’s faulty hip implants
pmc-11686521.creator: Vidya Menon
pmc-11686521.description: The Johnson and Johnson faulty hip implant case represents one of the most significant crises in medical device history, impacting nearly 93000 patients worldwide. In response to alarming failure rates and a global recall in August 2010, countries such as Australia, the United States, and the United Kingdom quickly implemented revision surgeries and reimbursement programs to protect patient safety.

pmc-12374308.title: H4K79 and H4K91 histone lactylation, newly identified lactylation sites enriched in breast cancer
pmc-12374308.creator: Jiena Liu, Liuying Zhao, Meisi Yan, Shengye Jin, Lingmin Shang, Jianyu Wang, Qin Wang, Shilu Zhao, Zibo Shen, Tong Liu, Hao Wu, Da Pang
pmc-12374308.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Metabolic reprogramming and epigenetic modification are two hallmarks of cancer. Protein lysine lactylation (Kla) is a novel type of glycolysis lactate-triggered posttranslational modification. However, the role of Kla in breast cancer (BC) remains largely unknown. Here, western blot, and immunohistochemical (IHC) staining of BC tissues revealed that global Kla levels were upregulated in BC tissues, and high levels of Kla were correlated with poor prognosis of patients with BC.

pmc-12559707.title: The global biomass of mammals since 1850
pmc-12559707.creator: Lior Greenspoon, Noam Ramot, Uri Moran, Uri Roll, Rob Phillips, Elad Noor, Ron Milo
pmc-12559707.description: Mammals are of central interest in ecology and conservation science. Here, we estimate the trajectory of mammal biomass globally over time — including humans, domesticated and wild mammals. According to our estimates, in the 1850s, the combined biomass of wild mammals was ≈200 Mt (million tonnes), roughly equal to that of humanity and its domesticated mammals at that time.

pmc-12649912.title: Systematic Review of Artificial Intelligence and Electrocardiography for Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosis
pmc-12649912.creator: Hernando Velandia, Aldo Pardo, María Isabel Vera, Miguel Vera
pmc-12649912.description: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the leading cause of death globally. Electrocardiograms (ECGs) are crucial diagnostic tools; however, their traditional interpretations exhibit limited sensitivity and reproducibility. This systematic review discusses the recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), including deep learning and machine learning, applied to ECG analysis for CVD detection.

pmc-12698150.title: Pursuit of Optimal Vagal Maneuvers in Stable Supraventricular Tachycardia: A Network Meta-Analysis
pmc-12698150.creator: Surya Sinaga Immanuel, Jesslyn Ellenia Gotama, Yeziel Sayogo, Alvin Sunjaya, Gabriel Tandecxi, Clifford Peter Anthony, Stephanie Aurelia Wirawan, Kevin Wibawa, Leonardo Paskah Suciadi
pmc-12698150.description: IntroductionVagal maneuvers are first-line therapy for hemodynamically stable supraventricular tachycardia (SVT), yet the relative efficacy of the standard Valsalva Maneuver (SVM), modified Valsalva maneuver (MVM), carotid-sinus massage (CSM), and head-down deep breathing (HDDB) remains uncertain. We undertook a network meta-analysis (NMA) to define the optimal technique and explore age- and sex-related effect modification.

pmc-12959174.title: Plaque-type dura mater graft-associated Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease: an autopsied case report
pmc-12959174.creator: Daisuke Tahara, Daichi Yokoi, Nao Tahara, Akio Akagi, Yuichi Riku, Jun Sone, Hiroaki Miyahara, Hirohisa Watanabe, Masahisa Katsuno, Yasushi Iwasaki
pmc-12959174.description: Clinicopathologically, dura mater graft-associated Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (dCJD) presents as either a non-plaque or plaque type. Here, we report an autopsy case of plaque-type dCJD, supported by genetic and biochemical analyses. A 41-year-old man manifested right-hand paraesthesia. He had received a dural graft in the right parietal region following a traumatic acute subdural haematoma 27 years before symptom onset.

pmc-13145497.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1817 ONLINE COGNITIVE SCREENING AFTER SUBARACHNOID HEMORRHAGE: THE AMSTERDAM COGNITION SCAN
pmc-13145497.creator: Teuni Ten Brink, Joris de Graaf, Philippine van Wijngaarden, Mervyn Vergouwen, Jeroen Boogaarts, R W Selles, C G M Meskers, Anne Visser-Meily
pmc-13145497.description: Background and aimsSubarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) can lead to persistent cognitive impairments that negatively affect quality of life and participation, yet these are often underrecognized. Online cognitive screening may offer a feasible method for early detection, but its applicability in the SAH population remains unclear.

pmc-13154451.title: Radionecrosis risk and local control after CyberKnife® fractionated stereotactic radiotherapy for brain metastases: an eight-year single-centre cohort
pmc-13154451.creator: Aurélia Alati, Philippe Giraud, Jean‑Emmanuel Bibault, Emmanuelle Fabiano, Sarah Kreps, Catherine Durdux
pmc-13154451.description: BackgroundStereotactic radiotherapy (SRT) is an effective treatment for patients with a limited number of brain metastases (BM). However, radionecrosis (RN) remains a concern, particularly in long-term survivors, as its distinction from tumor progression is challenging and may lead to inappropriate salvage strategies.

pmc-13176284.title: Editorial: Biomolecule production in plant synthetic biology
pmc-13176284.creator: Sichul Lee, Moonhyuk Kwon
pmc-13176284.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). gly, the application of plants is expanding into the synthetic biology field through the application of design, control, and biosynthetic systems to engineer plants. In this context, the Research Topic entitled “Biomolecule Production in Plant Synthetic Biology” presents emerging studies that, based on these new research directions and technologies, aim to industrially produce target molecules through the optimization of biological components, including molecular parts, and the redesign of metabolic pathways to develop and enhance heterologous plant platforms.

pmc-13629317.title: Prehospital management and outcomes of traumatic cardiac arrest in older adults: a French nationwide registry study
pmc-13629317.creator: Axel Benhamed, Baptiste Morcel, Jean-Stephane David, Ewoud Ter Avest, Tobias Gauss, James van Oppen, Karim Tazarourte, Eric Mercier, Bages-Limoges Florence, Bages-Limoges Florence, Dhers Marion, Fuster Patrick, Bellow Tobola, Peguet Olivier, Besnier Sylvie, Jardel Benoit, Buleon Clement, Avondo Aure
pmc-13629317.description: BackgroundTraumatic cardiac arrest (TCA) carries an overall poor prognosis, yet the impact of advanced age on prehospital management and outcomes remains poorly characterised. Whether older patients with TCA present distinct clinical profiles or respond differently to resuscitation compared with younger adults is largely unknown.MethodsWe conducted a multicenter cohort study using data from the French National Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest Registry (RéAC).

pmc-13632296.title: Regional distribution characteristics of eyelid Demodex in patients with squamous blepharitis
pmc-13632296.creator: Huiming Wen, Xiulan Li, Hongjuan Wang, Jingru Wang, Ling Zhang, Xiaoping Hong, Yingying Gao
pmc-13632296.description: PurposeTo investigate the regional distribution characteristics of different Demodex species in eyelash follicles of patients with squamous blepharitis, and to explore the correlation between Demodex distribution and ocular surface parameters.MethodsPatients with squamous blepharitis who visited the ophthalmology outpatient clinic from December 2024 to May 2025 were enrolled in this cross-sectional study.

pmc-13644154.title: Feasibility of shoulder joint visualization using the 0° Arthrex Nanoscope: a cadaveric study on twenty specimens
pmc-13644154.creator: Jędrzej Lesman, Błażej Wójtowicz, Łukasz Gołek, Michał Szufnara, Marcin Domżalski
pmc-13644154.description: PurposeNanoscopic technology is increasingly employed in minimally invasive orthopedic procedures, offering enhanced access to tight compartments with reduced soft-tissue disruption. This study assessed the feasibility of visualizing key anatomical structures of the shoulder joint using a 0° nanoscope in cadaveric specimens.
